text: Always do the allergy skin test that the colour maker and your colourist say you need. Do it even if you have used the colour before. Tell them if you have ever had a black henna tattoo.
Ask for a strand test before any lightening, so you and your colourist can see how your hair takes it.
Nobody can promise how many visits a colour change will take. Your colourist judges it as they go.
You told us hair dye or black henna has made your skin react before. Please ask a doctor or allergy clinic before you colour your hair. Do not test hair colour on your skin yourself.
A black henna tattoo can make a reaction to hair dye more likely. Please ask a doctor or allergy clinic before you colour your hair.

review.note: tattoo exposure asked on its own, whatever the hair history
